# Shruti 1.4.7
- Keeps every installed playback-capable app in the mixer whether it is silent or active, instead of removing rows a few seconds after playback stops. - Uses Core Audio activity only for the LIVE indicator and discovery; it never changes the user's manual app order. - Remembers uncommon applications after they produce real audio once, covering apps whose bundle metadata does not declare playback capability. - Expands installed-app recognition for browsers, media players, DAWs, communication apps, games and video editors, including ScreenFlow, while excluding capture-only utilities such as Wispr Flow and Camo. - Keeps searches and directories in deterministic name order so playback changes cannot make Chrome, Pianoteq, REAPER or another row jump around.
